build_NATransformerModel: build a non-autoregressive transformer model for sequence-to-sequence translation with length prediction
build_NATransformerDecoder: build a non-autoregressive transformer decoder with mean pooling and uniform assignment for length prediction
run_NATransformerModel_forward: run the NATransformerModel forward pass to encode source tokens and predict target tokens and length
run_NATransformerDecoder_forward_length: run the decoder length prediction using mean-pooled encoder features and an embedding lookup
run_NATransformerDecoder_extract_feature: run the decoder feature extraction with optional source embedding copy and early exit support
